notes.title: Grocery Store Simulator v1.0 Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004870/7f017ff8a2411655476024635176435bca95efee.png

Big News! Grocery Store Simulator is launching November 21st at 9 AM EST!

We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and this update is HUGE. Not only have we fixed a ton of issues, but we’ve also packed in some exciting new features and changes that we think you’re going to love. 

Here’s a preview of what’s coming:

Forklift + Bulk Ordering

 Now you can order pallets of items (36 per pallet) and move them around with a forklift!
 Save time with custom order presets—you can create, edit, or delete them as needed.
 Don’t worry, single-item ordering is still an option for those smaller orders.


Better Employee System

 Managing employees is now easier with a new, streamlined task interface.
 We’ve replaced the old “Take a Break” command with the highly requested Unload Truck feature (and yes, employees will take breaks on their own now).
 Plus, we’ve given employees a visual upgrade for a fresh new look!


Deliveries Made Easy

 There’s a brand-new Deliveries Tab where you can track all your orders and even cancel them if needed.


Proximity Voice Chat

 We’ve fixed the issue with voice chat only working in 2D. Now, it’s fully 3D, so you’ll hear your friends as if they’re right there with you!


Manual Garage Door

 You asked, and we listened: there’s now a button to manually open and close the garage door.


More Levels, More Items

 We’ve added 5 new store levels and 15 brand-new items to keep things fresh as you progress.


Jumping is Here!

 You all really wanted jumping, so we added it. And honestly? It’s way too fun to ever take out again.


...And So Much More!
This update is packed with improvements, surprises, and features we can’t wait for you to discover.

The countdown is on! Get ready to dive into Grocery Store Simulator on November 21st at 9 AM EST. 
See you there!

notes.title: Grocery Store Simulator v0.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[ NEW ]

 The cart is now interactable by holding the left mouse button (LMB).
 Added the ability to sell stocking carts.
 Added "In Storage" quantity indicator in the "Order Goods" tab.
 Increased market prices for fruits and vegetables.
 Rebranded several items.


[ FIXES ]

 Fixed issue where employees could be interacted with while sitting at a checkout counter.
 Fixed employees freezing when unable to return a box to a storage shelf.
 Fixed customers shuffling in the checkout line.
 Fixed several instability issues with the checkout counter.
 Fixed infinite money bug related to the checkout counter.
 Fixed crosshair recentering when clicking on the background of a credit card reader.
 Fixed issue with change sometimes remaining on a checkout counter after closing or picking it up.
 Fixed credit cards sometimes remaining in the reader after completing a transaction.
 Fixed bug allowing exit from checkout counter through walls.
 Fixed some shelf sections storing more items than others of the same size.
 Fixed issue where customers would reserve the front of queue when they are far away from the checkout line.
 Fixed employees not confirming transactions after taking money while sitting at a checkout counter.
 Fixed issue of employees sometimes getting stuck at the checkout counter.
 Fixed employees going outside the map to retrieve boxes.
 Fixed issue allowing interaction with one checkout counter while sitting at another.
 Fixed being able to pick up equipment while sitting at the computer.
 Fixed "In Stock" value display errors.
 Fixed incorrect values shown for "Store Level" and "Current Balance" on the computer.
 Fixed in-game menu crashes.
 Fixed some items not having shelf tags.
 Fixed some items not being displayed on boxes.
 Fixed various out-of-map interaction issues.

 Enhanced employee and customer movement.
 Improved employee stocking efficiency.
 Customers now consider the distance to checkout counters when choosing which one to use.
 Various visual improvements to checkout counters.
 Modified employee morale meter.

notes.title: Grocery Store Simulator v0.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[NEW]

 Added player customization.
 Added a hold-to-stock/take-back feature.
 Boxes now have dynamic labels.
 Wooden crates have been replaced with cardboard boxes.


[FIXES]

 The settings slider now properly adjusts the music volume.
 Fixed an issue where the maximum customer count would reset to store level 1.


[PERFORMANCE]

 Changed from DirectX 12 to DirectX 11, resulting in lower VRAM usage and overall better performance. This should also fix the issue where players experienced 1-5fps. NOTE: Physics work a bit differently now. If your store has a lot of boxes laying around, you may experience significant FPS drops. Try to keep the boxes on the storage shelves or throw them out in the dumpster until we optimize the physics.
 Improved lighting in the parking lot for better performance.


[MISC]

 Made minor changes to the Main Menu UI.
 Adjusted camera location when leaving checkout.

notes.title: Release Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We regret to inform you that the release of Grocery Store Simulator, originally scheduled for May 30th, has been delayed. We are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience, and we need a bit more time to ensure everything is just right. We understand this may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

While the game's Steam page will still display the original release date of May 30th, please note that the actual release will now occur sometime in June. We will share the new release date as soon as possible.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support. We are excited for you to experience Grocery Store Simulator and appreciate your patience as we put the finishing touches on the game.
